description: This file defines the ProductReview entity class used in the sales management system. It models product reviews with fields for rating, read count, review date, status, associated customer and product, and related descriptions. The class integrates with JPA for ORM mapping, including schema, table, and relationships to other entities.

classes.name: ProductReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a review of a product, including attributes like rating, review date, customer info, and associated product. It also manages audit information and related descriptions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the review.

methods.name: getReviewRating
methods.description: Gets the rating score given in the review.

methods.name: setReviewRating
methods.description: Sets the rating score for the review.

methods.name: getReviewRead
methods.description: Retrieves the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: setReviewRead
methods.description: Sets the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the review.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Gets the customer who wrote the review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with the review.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Gets the product associated with this review.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the product associated with this review.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of review descriptions.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section information for the review.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section information for the review.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Gets the date when the review was submitted.

methods.name: setReviewDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
